purpose: The seeded single-defect mutation set of the differential check (planning/mvp-m3-plan.md, Q8; work package M3-5): 91 mutations of Instance 1 (20), Instance 2 as te-poc (34), and Instance 3 as anchor (37). Each entry names its base instance and a defect: a kind of model/tools/gen-policy-fixtures.mjs's DEFECTS (Q8's single defects), whose parameters the generator draws from the seed and the entry's index, or, with edits, a label for the explicit single defect those edits make in the MVP checker's edit vocabulary (mvp/tools/policy-check.py, edit()). fails is the set of analyses that must fail it, written from security model v1's Part 3 definitions as the M3 checkers read them, not from any checker's output; an A1 failure leaves A2 to A8 unevaluated, so its set is A1 alone. claim is the named claim the mutation must falsify (S1 H39). model/tests/differential.sh requires count entries, at least Q8's 64, every fails nonempty, and every checker's failing set equal to fails. Hart-binding mutations are not here: the MVP checker reads no hart (Q8); tests/unit/policy_test.c has them.
